Name: MP Free Crafting and Cooking Mod
Author: suckzkid
Description:
[size=5][b]MP Free Crafting & Cooking Menu[/b][/size]

A clean, native wooden-styled menu for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] that lets you craft items and cook dishes [b]with zero required ingredients[/b], complete with a real-time search bar, crafted/cooked status indicators, custom quantity steppers, direct number typing, a batch-crafting Queue panel, and an optional Perfection progress grid.

[line]

[size=4][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Zero-Resource Crafting & Cooking:[/b] Craft any item or cook any dish immediately—no materials, workbench, or kitchen required.[/*]
[*][b]Real-Time Search Bar (Search: ):[/b] Filter recipes instantly by name across Crafting, Cooking, and Perfection tabs (press [b]/[/b] or [b]Tab[/b] to focus the search bar anytime).[/*]
[*][b]Crafted / Cooked Status Indicator:[/b] Every recipe row features a crisp status dot beneath the item name (🟢 [color=#2ecc40][b]Green[/b][/color] = already crafted/cooked at least once; 🔴 [color=#eb4034][b]Red[/b][/color] = not crafted/cooked yet) so you can track Perfection progress while browsing.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Quantities (1–999):[/b] Use the [b]-[/b] / [b]+[/b] buttons or click the quantity box to type an exact amount directly.[/*]
[*][b]Batch Craft Queue Panel:[/b] Queue multiple recipes and amounts on the right-hand panel and craft them all at once with [b]Craft All[/b] (or [b]Shift + Click[/b] any [b]Craft[/b]/[b]Cook[/b] button to craft immediately).[/*]
[*][b]Full Perfection Support:[/b] Includes all base-game crafting and cooking recipes (including unlearned blueprints) and automatically credits crafted/cooked items toward your [b]100% Perfection[/b] tracker.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Perfection Visual Grid:[/b] Enable the third [b]Perfection[/b] tab in Generic Mod Config Menu to view a visual Collections-style grid of every crafted and cooked item.[/*]
[*][b]Full GMCM Integration:[/b] Customize your hotkey ([b]K[/b] by default) and toggle the Search Bar, Locked/Unlearned Recipes, Perfection Tab, or Queue Panel on or off anytime.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🎮 Controls & Hotkeys[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]K[/b] [i](configurable in GMCM)[/i] — Open the [b]MP Free Crafting & Cooking Menu[/b].[/*]
[*][b]/[/b] or [b]Tab[/b] — Focus the [b]Search: [/b]bar while the menu is open.[/*]
[*][b]Click on Craft / Cook[/b] — Add the selected quantity to your Queue (or craft immediately if the Queue panel is disabled).[/*]
[*][b]Shift + Click on Craft / Cook[/b] — Craft or cook immediately, bypassing the Queue.[/*]
[*][b]Click on the Quantity Box[/b] — Type any number from [b]1[/b] to [b]999[/b], then press [b]Enter[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Mouse Wheel[/b] — Scroll through recipe pages (or scroll the Queue list when hovering over the Queue panel).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][i](Optional, recommended)[/i] Install [url=https://nexusmods.com]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Download [b]FreeCraftMod.zip[/b] and extract the [b]FreeCraftMod[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (config.json / GMCM)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod[/b] [i](Default: true)[/i] — Master toggle to enable or disable the menu hotkey.[/*]
[*][b]Open Menu Hotkey[/b] [i](Default: K)[/i] — Keybind used to open the menu in-game.[/*]
[*][b]Show Search Bar[/b] [i](Default: true)[/i] — Displays the typeable [b]Search: [/b]filter bar at the top of the menu.[/*]
[*][b]Show Locked / Unlearned Recipes[/b] [i](Default: true)[/i] — Lists all game recipes even before unlocking blueprints or Queen of Sauce episodes.[/*]
[*][b]Show Perfection Tab[/b] [i](Default: false)[/i] — Adds a third side tab with a visual grid of crafted and cooked items.[/*]
[*][b]Enable Craft Queue Panel[/b] [i](Default: true)[/i] — Shows the right-side Queue panel for batch crafting.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🙏 Credits & Inspiration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Inspired by the original [b]FreeCraft[/b] mod concept—designed and built from scratch with the help of AI-assisted coding, featuring a custom wooden UI, real-time search bar, crafted/cooked status indicators, quantity steppers, batch craft queue, Perfection tracking, and full Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[*]Built for [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] with optional integration for [url=https://nexusmods.com]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]📋 Changelog[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]v0.0.1[/b] — Initial public release featuring Crafting & Cooking tabs, real-time [b]Search: [/b]bar, 🟢/🔴 crafted/cooked status dots, 1–999 quantity steppers & direct typing, batch Craft Queue panel, full 153-recipe Perfection tracking (including Wedding Ring), optional Perfection grid tab, and Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[/list]
